purpose.domain_detail: Tribunal jury management system (ProjetGesTrib) — manages jurors, convocations, court sessions, cases, and courtrooms for a French tribunal
purpose.summary: A menu-driven COBOL application for managing tribunal (court) operations. It handles CRUD operations for jurors (jurés), convocations, court sessions (séances), cases (affaires), and courtrooms (salles). It also supports queries such as finding unconvoked jurors, unvalidated convocations, and available rooms.
